svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Print in light grey PETG, 0.2 mm layers, 4 walls, 30 % infill,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: roof lip down on the bed so the walls need no supports.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Outside 92 x 64 x 18 mm: two side walls and a back wall 2 mm thick,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: a roof lip 20 mm deep along the back; open at the front (user side).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Four tabs inside the side walls, 7.5 x 10 x 3 mm, flush with the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: bottom edge, centred 21.5 mm each side of the hood's middle.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Tab holes 3.4 mm: 79 mm apart across, 43 mm apart front to back;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 7 mm screwdriver holes through the roof lip over the two back tabs.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: four M3 x 20 screws with sealing washers pass through the tabs,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the lid and the spacers and also hold the display board.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the hood's top is level with the isolator knob top, 98 mm up.
